instruction: We represent Mouloul Energy Materials, Inc., which is buying all outstanding shares of the Company from Porert Industrial Holdings, LLC under a stock purchase agreement. Please review all seven documents in the folder and prepare a memo to me identifying each issue you find. For each, note where it appears (document and section), why it matters to Mouloul as buyer, and your recommended fix. Please flag anything you can't resolve from the documents alone.

rubric.text: The response identifies that the environmental termination window in SPA Section 9.1(e) runs 45 days from the February 9, 2026 Letter of Intent date and so closed on or about March 26, 2026, before the May 11, 2026 SPA date. As a result, Buyer would sign with no usable environmental walk-away right, contrary to the LOI's 30-days-after-signing review period. The response locates the issue in SPA Section 9.1(e) or LOI Section 6, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: 45 days after the date of the Letter of Intent

rubric.text: The response identifies that the IP Assignment Agreement defines 'Recycling Process Technology' as only the patents listed on its Exhibit A. As a result, the Company would not receive the trade secrets, know-how, process parameters and software that the SPA's broader definition and assignment covenant promise. The response locates the issue in IP Assignment Agreement Section 1.1 or SPA Section 6.6, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the TSA's choice of Texas law and exclusive Harris County, Texas forum conflicts with the SPA's New York governing law and New York County forum clause, which covers Ancillary Agreements. The response locates the issue in TSA Section 12.7 or SPA Section 11.10, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: laws of the State of Texas

rubric.text: The response identifies that the TSA lets the Provider (Seller) assign the agreement to any person, including a competitor of the Company, without the Recipient's consent. The response locates the issue in TSA Section 12.3, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
The response states that under the SPA's order of precedence, each Ancillary Agreement controls over the SPA as to its own subject matter.
hints: controls as to its own subject matter

rubric.text: The response is presented as a memo that addresses each issue separately and, for each issue, states the document and section, why it matters to the buyer, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that, as drafted, Buyer's environmental termination right under SPA Section 9.1(e) remains exercisable after the SPA is signed on May 11, 2026.
